message.content:
Based on my search, here are some of the best places where you can order a birthday cake online, depending on your location and needs:

## International & US-Based Options

**Bake Me a Wish** - A premier nationwide bakery in the US for gourmet birthday cakes with personalized messages, overnight shipping to all 50 states, and options like kosher and gluten-free cakes. Cakes come in colorful gift boxes with personalized cards.

**Goldbelly** - Perfect if you want iconic cakes from famous bakeries across the US (like Carlo's, Ovenly, and others). Great for special dietary needs including vegan, paleo, gluten-free, and kosher options.

**Milk Bar** - Known for their best-selling vanilla rainbow birthday cake that can be delivered nationwide in the US.

## UK Options

**Waitrose** - Offers online cake delivery starting from £13.50 with a range of birthday and celebration cakes, including themed fondant cakes for children's parties.

**The Hummingbird Bakery** - London-based bakery specializing in American-inspired colorful cakes, with delivery available for London postcodes. Known for their rainbow piñata cake.

## India & South Asia

**IGP (Indian Gifts Portal)** - Offers online cake delivery across 400+ Indian cities and 100+ countries. Features birthday cakes, photo cakes, pinata cakes, rainbow cakes, and same-day/midnight delivery options.

**Bakingo** - Popular Indian online bakery with same-day and 2-hour free delivery options, plus fixed-time, early morning, and midnight delivery services. Wide variety of flavors including Ferrero Rocher, Kit-kat, and Oreo cakes.

**FNP (Ferns N Petals)** - Major Indian platform with 2-hour delivery in 350+ cities, offering designer cakes, photo cakes, eggless options, and midnight delivery.

## Southeast Asia & Middle East

**FNP Malaysia** - Birthday cake delivery across Malaysia with same-day and midnight delivery options, including cartoon cakes, photo cakes, and themed designer cakes.

**Habib Bakery (Dubai/UAE)** - Offers same-day and next-day birthday cake delivery in Dubai and Sharjah, with custom and designer cake options.

**Flower Chimp (Philippines)** - Cake delivery across the Philippines, partnering with local bake shops including Red Ribbon, with options to add flowers, chocolates, and balloons.

## Hong Kong

**I Love Babycakes** - Homestyle cakes with delivery all over Hong Kong, plus baking classes and DIY kits.

**Vission Bakery** - Custom order cakes with pickup or delivery across Hong Kong, including vegan and dairy-free options.

## General Tips for Ordering
- Most platforms offer customization (messages, photos, themes)
- Same-day and midnight delivery are commonly available
- Many sites have filters for dietary restrictions (eggless, gluten-free, vegan)
- Prices typically start around $40-50 USD for premium cakes, with supermarket options starting lower
